name: Brickellia

project_scope.learner_admission: Approved Master Plant Pool; both UNRESOLVED; B. eupatorioides var. gracillima represented by species concept.

look_here_first: Inspect leaf nodes, then the lower leaf surface, layered phyllaries of a mature head, and finally mature cypsela and pappus under magnification.

comparison.eupatorioides: Usually opposite, but alternate in some varieties.
Variable across varieties; not diagnosed by dense lower-face tomentum alone.

comparison.cylindracea: Check mature bristles and cypsela hairs against FNA.
Often opposite/subopposite leaves and pale-tomentose lower surface.
comparison.dentata: Alternate leaves; 18–22 phyllaries in 5–6 series; 13–20 disk florets; mature cypsela mostly glabrous, 3.5–4 mm.
comparison.eupatorioides: Phyllotaxy variable across varieties; mature pappus plumose/subplumose.

cautions: B. eupatorioides var. gracillima is nested; do not create an unreviewed duplicate card.
Both installed species remain UNRESOLVED for target-zone range; no confirmed-native credit.
B. dentata is already canonical; B. eupatorioides var. gracillima remains represented under the species concept. All three have unresolved range labels.
visual_status: Provisional comparison; macro photos of nodes, heads, and mature fruits needed.
shared_genus_traits: Heads consist of disc florets, with overlapping involucral phyllaries and cypselae bearing pappus bristles.
Examine mature heads, pappus and leaf surfaces together; no single leaf character separates every species.
Three canonical species; heads discoid with layered phyllaries and pappus-bearing cypselae.
diagnostic_photo_checklist: Matched mature head profiles with millimeter scale and labeled phyllary series
Matched mature cypsela and pappus macros
Leaf-node phyllotaxy and underside hair/gland-dot closeups
B. dentata: exact-species photo still needed (species images[] empty).
All three: matched leaf nodes, phyllary profiles, and mature pappus/cypsela macros.
